items.comments: Kelsey was a really thoughtful host, leaving nice little details such as delicious snacks and a cute welcome note to her private room. This is a great location with free parking 24/7 (bonus!) that's close to downtown and easily accessible. Her house mates were also thoughtful and nice. There's a comfy single bed, a cozy private shower/bathroom -- worked great for my solo weekend work trip to Seattle! Kelsey is also very responsive and easy to communicate with.
The host canceled this reservation the day before arrival. This is an automated posting.
Great place for young folks to enjoy a stay in Seattle. Close enough to get to the main hub of the city, yet not too close, so you have some breathing room away from the business of the city.
